- Premise 2 implies that anything not an ingredient of Brow Powder Duo cannot be an ingredient of PRO LONGLASH.

Therefore, if something is not an ingredient of MAVA-WHITE, it must be an ingredient of Brow Powder Duo. This means being an ingredient of Brow Powder Duo is necessary for not being an ingredient of MAVA-WHITE.
